final_text:
I visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack, and sent each of them feedback by direct message.

- **Dora:** I invited her at dora@securemail-hub.com, then told her the site is clean and shows her contact email up front. I suggested adding more about her work, projects and interests, plus visuals and clearer navigation.
- **Eve:** I told her the blog has a personal touch and her love of hiking comes through. I suggested more content, such as trail stories, photos and tips. I also suggested some structure, like categories and a post archive.
